text:
Riverdale Branch Library (fictional)
ENGLISH CONVERSATION CIRCLE
Practise speaking English in a friendly group led by volunteers. All levels welcome.
When: Wednesdays, 6:30 p.m. to 8:00 p.m., starting September 16, 2026
Where: Community room, 2nd floor
Cost: Free. Register at the information desk or online.
Don't have a library card? Bring proof of your address and we will make one for free.
